Resets a Key-Value Storage to the initial state.
ResetKeyValueStorage allows to reset a Key-Value Storage to the initial state, containing only
key-value pairs which were deployed from the manifest, with their initial values. Afterwards, the
Key-Value Storage will appear as if it was newly installed from the current manifest.
It will fail with kResourceBusy when the Key-Value Storage is currently open, or when it is
modified by a call from another thread to UpdatePersistency, CleanUpPersistency, Reset
Persistency, RecoverKeyValueStorage, or ResetKeyValueStorage.
